audit.whatIsWrong: Two real mechanics are missing and one is misdescribed. (a) Twisted Advance makes Maokai UNTARGETABLE for the duration of the dash — Riot's text says so explicitly — and nothing on the page mentions it, even though the page tells the player to E him on cooldown. (b) Sap Magic's cooldown is reduced 'each time Maokai casts a spell OR IS STRUCK BY AN ENEMY'S SPELL', so every Undertow the player lands accelerates his heal. (c) Ragnarok is called a cleanse in four strings; Riot's text is immunity to disables for as long as Olaf keeps attacking.
audit.why: (a) costs the player their highest-value button: Reckless Swing is on an 11-second cooldown at rank 1 and paid for in health, and throwing it at an untargetable dash wastes both. The correct play is to hold it for landfall. (b) inverts the poke plan — the page's whole early-game advice is to chip him with axes, which is exactly what refunds his sustain, so the right instruction is to burst rather than grind. (c) is the timing reversal the mirror agent already flagged on the other side: the immunity has to be running before the root lands, and it drops the moment Olaf stops swinging.

Twisted Advance's 14s and Nature's Grasp's 130s added.

notes: Two findings here beyond the chart. First, Twisted Advance grants untargetability during the dash and the page never said so while simultaneously telling the player to press E on cooldown — that is a wasted 11-second, health-costing ability every time. Second, Sap Magic's cooldown drops when Maokai is STRUCK by an enemy spell, not only when he casts one, which means the page's poke-him-with-axes advice was feeding his sustain; the corrected text says burst rather than grind. Separately, content.early, mid and late were written in the first person ('Level 1 is mine: I throw Q...') — the only page in my slice like this, and worth grepping the content layer for other champions with the same voice slip. dosFull[1].t still reads 'R to cleanse his W root' at 23 characters, under the applier's skip threshold, so it needs a manual edit to match the corrections made everywhere else.
